items.title: Prompt debt is the new tech debt. With every model update, you should be cutting at least 50% o…
items.content: Prompt debt is the new tech debt. With every model update, you should be cutting at least 50% of your prompts. Most AI products have bloated prompts that are making your product quality worse. The typical flow is: model fails at something -> add 10 rules. Tool call fails -> add 10 examples. Output is weird -> add formatting constraints. 3 months later, your system prompt is a novel. Meanwhile the model is way smarter and your micro-managey prompts are turning it into a dumb rules machine.
